name: Bullet Time
description: Time freezes mid-leap in a rainy alley while the camera orbits the suspended subject.

wardrobe.man: a long dark grey coat, black trousers and boots
wardrobe.woman: a long dark grey coat, black trousers and boots
wardrobe.person: a long dark grey coat, black trousers and boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} is frozen mid-air in a powerful leap across a narrow rainy alley at night, both feet off the ground, body horizontal and twisting, coat flaring out, wearing {wardrobe}. Every raindrop hangs frozen in the air like glass beads, a splash of water from the puddle below is frozen in a crown, and neon reflections glow on the wet bricks. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered in the air. Cinematic night photography, cool blue light with magenta neon accents, frozen motion. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain brick walls with neon reduced to soft abstract glows throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided first image as the first frame and the provided last image as the last frame. Time is frozen for the whole shot: the {subject} hangs motionless mid-leap like a statue, and every raindrop and the water splash below stay suspended in place. The camera alone moves, orbiting smoothly in a half circle around the frozen {subject}, from the side seen in the first frame to the opposite side seen in the last frame, the frozen drops in the foreground sliding past the lens. FROZEN TIME LAW: the body, the coat, the hair, the drops and the splash hold the same shape in every frame and only the point of view changes; any movement of the {subject} or of a single drop = failed take. Sound: a single low held drone, one slow heartbeat, a faint high ringing. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, frozen-time look with crisp suspended droplets, sharp detail, stable picture.
